# Skopli

> An open-source SDK (MIT) that reads the session logs of 40 coding-agent harnesses from local disk, rolls them up, and prices them against market catalogs. 9 languages over one Rust core. No account, no telemetry.

Read and Rollup never touch the network. Price fetches OpenRouter, LiteLLM, and models.dev catalogs by default, caches them, and works offline from the cache; an unmatched model returns `priced: false` with the keys it tried instead of a guessed rate.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://docs.skopli.com/skopli/): guides and reference; every page has a Markdown twin (append .md), plus /skopli/llms.txt and /skopli/llms-full.txt
- [GitHub](https://github.com/skopli/skopli): source and issues
